description: ArgoCD GitOps connector. Surfaces ArgoCD applications — name, namespace, project, sync status (Synced/OutOfSync), health status (Healthy/Degraded/Progressing/Missing/Suspended), source repo + path + target revision, and destination cluster/namespace — into the local index as `argocd:application` items, enabling deployment correlation ("did this app go OutOfSync when the alert fired?"). Two HITL-gated write tools: `argocd_app_sync` (trigger an application sync, HITL `argocd.app.sync`) and `argocd_app_rollback` (roll back to a prior deployment history id, HITL `argocd.app.rollback`); both are async (the action is requested — verify via the next metadata sync). Bearer-JWT auth (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`, an ArgoCD API token from `argocd account generate-token`). ArgoCD is always self-hosted: the server host is supplied via the `argocd.url` vault key and added to the sandbox network list at spawn time by `phase3AddArgocdMcp`, so the static manifest network list is intentionally empty. v1 indexes applications only — AppProjects + per-app sync history are a deferred follow-up. Destructive `argocd.app.delete` remains deferred.
author: Nimbus
